core.evolution: Evolves into Ivysaur starting at level 16; Ivysaur evolves into Venusaur at level 32.

diet: The back bulb supplies energy through photosynthesis and nutrient-rich seeds.
It can go for days without eating.
Its vines can pull it into trees to reach Berries.
habitat: Found in grasslands and forests; wild individuals are uncommon because many are raised for Trainers.
Also recorded in the Blueberry Academy Terarium.
geographic_range: Naturally associated with the Kanto region; also recorded in the Blueberry Academy Terarium.
behavior: Shows strong loyalty and has displayed nurturing behavior toward younger or weaker Pokémon.
social_structure: Many gather yearly in a hidden Kanto garden for an evolution ceremony led by a Venusaur.
activity_cycle: Known to sleep or bask in sunny spots; no specific nocturnal or diurnal classification is given.
likes_preferences: Frequently basks in bright, sunny places.
physical_characteristics: Small quadrupedal amphibian-like body with blue-green skin, darker patches, red eyes, pointed ear-like structures, a blunt snout, visible upper teeth, and three claws on each foot.
A green plant bulb grows on its back and contains slender vines.
adaptations: The bulb provides stored nutrients and photosynthetic energy.
Long strong vines can grasp branches and help it climb.
communication: Has used its vines gently to comfort younger Pokémon and has been shown singing while doing so.
The bulb flashes blue when it is ready to evolve.
reproduction_mating: Game breeding data places it in the Monster and Grass Egg Groups with a hatch time of 20 cycles.
parenting_young: Young Bulbasaur draw nourishment from the seed on their back as they grow.
The species has displayed a nurturing instinct toward smaller or weaker Pokémon.
hunting_foraging_style: Uses sunlight and stored seed nutrients for energy and can use its vines to reach Berries.
lifespan_life_cycle: The seed on its back grows with its body.
It evolves into Ivysaur at level 16 and later into Venusaur at level 32.
